data.name: Arban
data.gender_notes: Arban is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arban is derived from the Arabic word ‘arb’ meaning mountain. The suffix ‘an’ adds the meaning of ‘my rock’. This name symbolizes strength and resilience, reminding us of the unwavering support of Allah (swt). The name Arban carries the meaning “Mountain of My Rock” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arban usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of my rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reminder of Allah's constant support and strength
data.etymology: Arban belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain of My Rock.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arban total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
